create_pose: create a Pose with a position and quaternion and multiply it by another Pose using mul
compute_world_pose: compute the world pose of a PoseStamped by calling get_world_pose with a Physics object
transform_twist: transform a TwistStamped to a new frame using to_frame or get_world_twist with a Physics object
transform_wrench: transform a WrenchStamped to a new frame using to_frame or get_world_wrench with a Physics object
compute_relative_pose: compute the relative pose between two frames using frame_relative_pose with an optional Physics object
